## Requirements (spec §5f.1 §9 + §5f.2 scope table + §5f.4 §9, C0/Stage 1 rows only)
1. `Validator` class contract — `ValidatorDeclaration` schema + `declare`/`bind` validation (I-V1, judge ⇒ ¬deterministic ∧ profile_ref ∧ assumption_debt; `ValidatorHasEffects`; `IncompleteDeclaration`); `ClassRecord{class_id = validator, ordered-many, required_inputs ⊇ {ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}}`.
2. `Verdict`/`EvidenceHandle`/`EvidenceBundle` schemas + verdict event payloads; `inputs_digest`; `ClaimOnlyEvidence` + no-rewrite rules; `EvidenceMissing/Stale/Unauthoritative/Tampered` collect checks.
3. Kernel local checks (a)–(c) at the verify placement (after `action.effect.observed`); `verify` placement.
4. `ValidatesRecord`/`TaskContract`/`VerificationSummary`/`EvidenceRequirement` schemas; `deliver` precondition (`HeldOutLeak`); pinned members (declaration-side).
5. `Claim`/`ClaimKind`/`SubjectRef`/`ReconciliationRecord`/`AuthoritativeHandle` schemas; `extract` (structured `finish` fields; authority = delegate; `AuthorityExceedsOrigin`; `NoClaimSurface`/`MalformedClaim`); `bind` kind map; `SeverityRecord` + execution-alignment register.
6. `verification.claim.recorded`/`claim.reconciled`/`gate.evaluated`/`validator.verdict`/`completion.proposed`/`artefact.followed` class registrations + payload builders (audit-grade, provenance-mandatory).
7. `reconciliation.holds` dimension (gauge cap) in `hh-ontology`; `GateResult` schema; Γ schema + floors as kernel constants + `validate` refusal on loosening + conditioned-row debt records.
8. ADR-0114 D1 deterministic metric declarations registered (`false_completion_rate` veto; `execution_alignment_failure_rate_judged`/`belief_divergence` distinct, never merged); `execution_alignment` class registration with floors-only default.
9. `CriticDeclaration` (OracleDeclaration ∪ critic fields); closed `evidence_class`; `EvidenceBundle`/`CriticVerdict` schemas; verdict payload extensions (`bundle_id`/`evidence_cited`/`calibration_ref`/`independence_summary`/`uncited_findings`); `IndependenceVector` + minimums; `CalibrationRecord`; exploratory rule; `RedundantJudge` check (Stage-1 executable); `critic_gate` rule shape; `grounding` derivation + `consume` admissibility (`GroundingInsufficient`).
10. Reference-harness wiring: `verification.claim.recorded` on `stop{completed}` (driver); kernel local verdicts on `action.effect.observed` (dispatcher).

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-R-2.7.1-1 local checks (a)–(c) appended per `action.effect.observed`, deterministic, `inputs_digest`, `charged_to = subject`; observation byte-identical. (d) is Stage-2 per ADR-0111(e) → DF-S1.21-1.
- AC-R-2.7.1-2 `ValidatorHasEffects` at `bind`; no fabric op mutates a durable observation.
- AC-R-2.7.1-3 `ClaimOnlyEvidence`; transcript-only evidence ⇒ no pass.
- AC-R-2.7.1-4 deterministic `check` pure in `(inputs_digest, validator version_id)`; byte change ⇒ digest change.
- AC-R-2.7.1-11 `Validator` ClassRecord `required_inputs ⊇ {ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}`.
- AC-R-2.7.1-12 assumption-debt on threshold-conditioned validators (`IncompleteDeclaration`).
- AC-R-2.7.2a-1 `stop{completed}` ⇒ ≥1 `verification.claim.recorded` (kind ∈ {achieved, unachievable}, criteria_status aligned, provenance delegate); authority > delegate ⇒ `AuthorityExceedsOrigin`.
- AC-R-2.7.2a-9 ADR-0114 D1 declarations registered; `false_completion_rate` veto; judged names never merge.
- AC-R-2.7.2a-10 Γ loosening F2–F7 refused at `validate`; conditioned Γ rows carry debt records.
- AC-R-2.7.3-1 (schema half) all-`claimed` bundle ⇒ `grounding = claimed`; `consume(report|gate)` ⇒ `GroundingInsufficient`; one `measured` item admissible.
- AC-R-2.7.3-13 judge beside a deterministic check at the same decision point ⇒ `RedundantJudge`; ordering verifiable from the declaration.
- Universal phase-gate AC: tests/fmt/clippy green; requirement ids stamped; DEFERRALS rows; ADRs; index+ledger advanced.

## Plan
New persistent crate `crates/hh-verification` (the P4 substrate; deps wire/identity/provenance/ontology/hir/ledger only — CC10, matches hh-control/hh-env precedent). `hh-ledger` +5 class rows (`invoked` upgraded to audit-grade — it was already registered; the spec's audit list names it). `hh-ontology` +`reconciliation.holds` gauge. `hh-registry::suites` +`validator_class`/`execution_alignment_class` (floors-only default). `hh-telemetry` grounding declarations (ADR-0114 D1) + fix two provisional `computed_from` spellings. `hh-env::dispatch` appends local verdicts after `action.effect.observed`. `hh-control::driver` emits `completion.proposed` + `claim.recorded` on `stop{completed}` via `EffectGate::finish_record` (defaulted trait method — additive). ADR-0257 for the owned decisions.
